role: Shared vocabulary of the assistant's provider layer: ProviderID identity/branding, ModelOption catalog entries, ChatTurn transcript model (with hand-written tolerant decoder), ToolSpec/ToolExchange tool-use types, AIStreamEvent stream events, API-key redaction, AIProviderError (fallback/guardrail/blocked-reply policy + user text), ProviderAccountReply credit/purchase detection, ProviderHTTP (the cloud streamers' shared URL session, error-body/envelope/status mapping with the shared non-2xx mapping statusFailure and its 300-character body excerpt, the per-provider overloaded text, mid-stream error objects, SSE event parsing, tool-argument JSON check, cache-marker split and <live_state> envelope), the AIProvider protocol, the KeyedCloudProvider protocol that supplies the five cloud providers' key and catalog members, and AnyJSON encoder.
types: ProviderID: enum — the six AI backends (apple, anthropic, openai, gemini, grok, deepseek) with display/vendor/symbol/privacy URL
ModelOption: struct — one selectable model (apiID, context window, per-MTok prices, default flag)
AssistantSubsystem: enum — which AI surface produced a turn (coach, workoutVoiceCoach, voiceConversation, coachReport)
ChatTurn: struct — one persisted chat message (role, text, provider/model, subsystem, routed tier, localOnly, incomplete)
ToolSpec: struct — tool name/description/JSON input schema sent to providers
ToolExchange: struct — a completed tool call + serialized result replayed in continuation requests
AIProviderError: enum (LocalizedError) — provider failure taxonomy (blockedReply: a cloud vendor's safety stop) with isFallbackable/isAppleGuardrail/isBlockedReply and localized messages
ProviderAccountReply: enum — string heuristics for credit-exhausted and purchase-prompt vendor replies
ProviderHTTP: enum — HTTP plumbing shared by AnthropicProvider, GeminiProvider and OpenAICompatibleStreamer
AIProvider: protocol — backend interface (id, models, key need, availability, tool cap, streaming send)
KeyedCloudProvider: protocol (AIProvider) — a cloud provider on the user's API key; requires static models
KeyedCloudProvider: extension — availableModels = Self.models, requiresKey true, isAvailable from the key store
AIProvider: extension — default maxToolSchemaCount nil and 4-argument toolless send
AnyJSON: struct (Encodable) — re-encodes JSONSerialization output via Codable
state: mem:ProviderHTTP.streamSession (one URLSession: waitsForConnectivity, 30 s request / 180 s resource timeouts, 4 connections per host, no URL cache)
mem:ProviderHTTP.serverFailureTypes (private static let: server_error, overloaded_error, api_error)
mem:ProviderHTTP.errorExcerptLength = 300 (static let; most characters of a raw error body shown)
toplevel: Conformances: ProviderID String/Codable/CaseIterable/Identifiable; ModelOption Codable/Hashable/Identifiable/Sendable; AssistantSubsystem String/Codable; ChatTurn Codable (synthesized encode, custom decode)/Identifiable/Hashable/Sendable with stored defaults localOnly=false and incomplete=false (a reply whose stream failed partway); ToolSpec Hashable/Codable/Sendable; AIStreamEvent.usage has default 0 for cache fields; AIProviderError LocalizedError.

Read by AssistantViewModel+Routing.swift:632 to walk the fallback chain.

branches.effect: true (treated as fallbackable so misconfiguration does not dead-end the chat)

The one URLSession every cloud streamer sends through: waitsForConnectivity (a cellular tower handoff waits instead of failing), 30 s request / 180 s resource timeouts, cellular/constrained/expensive access allowed, 4 connections per host, no URL cache.
units.entry: Initialised on first use by AnthropicProvider.stream, GeminiProvider.stream or OpenAICompatibleStreamer.connect.

units.does: Drains a failed response's byte stream into Data, stopping at 4096 bytes, for diagnostics.

Pulls error.message out of a vendor JSON error envelope ({"error":{"message":...}}, Anthropic's and Gemini's shape), redacted of API keys; nil when the body is not JSON, has no error object, or the message is empty.

branches.cond: no error object or empty message

units.does: The error a non-2xx reply becomes for every cloud provider: decodes the body as UTF-8 (empty when it is not) and redacts API keys; a credit-exhausted reply (ProviderAccountReply.isCreditExhausted) is .outOfCredit(provider); otherwise the provider's override gets the status, raw body and redacted text, and its error is used when it returns one; anything left maps through statusError with the envelope's error.message (errorMessage) or the first errorExcerptLength (300) characters of the redacted body, and the provider's overloaded text for 5xx.

branches.cond: credit exhausted (402 or a credit phrase in the text)

branches.effect: that message (redacted); otherwise the first 300 characters of the redacted body

units.does: Maps an HTTP failure status to the AIProviderError the chat shows: 401/403 authFailed, 429 rateLimited, 404 modelUnavailable(message), 5xx modelUnavailable(overloaded) — the caller's localized 'try again' sentence, evaluated only then — and anything else invalidResponse('HTTP <status>: <message>').

Returns the localized 'try again' sentence for a provider whose servers are overloaded or failing: the catalogued 'Anthropic is overloaded…' and 'Gemini is overloaded…' sentences for those two, and '<displayName> is overloaded right now. Try again in a moment.' for the others.

For a stream payload carrying an {"error":{...}} object (an OpenAI-compatible or Gemini chunk, an Anthropic error event), returns the error the chat acts on: .modelUnavailable(overloadedMessage(provider)) when the error is the vendor's own failure (numeric code 500-599, or type server_error / overloaded_error / api_error), the same mapping statusError gives a 5xx; otherwise .invalidResponse with the redacted error.message ('stream error' when absent). Nil when the payload has no error object.

Parses one SSE data payload as a JSON object. A payload that is not JSON, or is JSON but not an object, throws .invalidResponse('malformed <vendorName> stream event') so a broken event fails the stream instead of being skipped.

branches.effect: throws the same error; otherwise returns the object

units.does: True when the text parses as a JSON object (a tool call's complete arguments); false for a fragment, a non-object or anything that does not parse.
